fact.text: In 1970, Oregon highway officials tried to get rid of a rotting beached sperm whale by blowing it up with dynamite. It did not go to plan.

heads_up: Muitinė įspėja: lapkričio 9–10 d. jos sistemomis naudojusiųsi asmenų duomenys galėjo nutekėti.
Nuo gruodžio protestuojantys aplinkosaugininkai nebevykdys aplinkos priežiūros visą parą.

lithuania.headline: Vyriausybė apmokestins naftos perdirbėjų viršpelnį
lithuania.summary: Premjeras Mindaugas Sinkevičius paskelbė, kad bus apmokestinamas naftos perdirbimo įmonių viršpelnis, o koalicija jau sutarė apmokestinti lošimus ir didinti saldintų gėrimų akcizą – Finansų ministerija siūlo jį padvigubinti. Verslo organizacijos ragina nekelti mokesčių, o mažinti viešąsias išlaidas.
lithuania.context: Papildomų pajamų reikia, kad Lietuva galėtų skirti gynybai daugiau nei 5 proc. BVP; 2027 m. biudžeto projekte numatytas 3,8 proc. BVP skolinimasis. Lietuvos banko vadovas ir dalis Seimo Biudžeto ir finansų komiteto narių projektą kritikuoja.

lithuania.headline: Lietuvoje lankosi Kinijos diplomatai, siekiama atkurti santykius
lithuania.summary: Į Lietuvą atvykę Kinijos užsienio reikalų ministerijos atstovai trečiadienį susitiko su Seimo narių grupe už santykių normalizavimą, o ketvirtadienį URM vyksta darbinio lygio konsultacijos dėl diplomatų akreditavimo Vilniuje ir Pekine. Premjeras Sinkevičius sako, kad Pekinas kol kas nereikalauja keisti Taivaniečių atstovybės pavadinimo.
lithuania.context: 2021 m. pabaigoje Vilniuje atidarius Taivaniečių atstovybę, Kinija sumažino diplomatinių santykių lygį ir įvedė Lietuvai griežtas diplomatines bei ekonomines sankcijas. Dabartinės Vyriausybės programoje numatyta santykius normalizuoti iki kitų ES šalių lygio.

lithuania.headline: Nutekėjo 125 mln. SMS žinučių su Lietuvos įmonių ir klientų duomenimis
lithuania.summary: Viešai prieinamoje „CSCTelecom“ Latvijos padalinio duomenų bazėje rasta daugiau nei 125 mln. žinučių iš 2022 m. spalio–2026 m. rugsėjo, tarp jų „Iki“, „Depo“, „Akropolio“, „airBaltic“ klientų telefonų numeriai, užsakymų duomenys ir prisijungimo kodai. Bazė uždaryta spalio 27 d.
lithuania.context: Tokie duomenys leidžia sukčiams rengti tikslines atakas, pavyzdžiui, perimti vienkartinius prisijungimo kodus.

world.headline: Democrat Scott Colom wins Senate seat in Mississippi
world.summary: Scott Colom beat Republican incumbent Cindy Hyde-Smith by fewer than 5,000 votes, 49.2% to 48.7%, becoming the first Black senator from Mississippi in more than 140 years. Democrats now hold 55 of 100 Senate seats, with Alaska still undecided.
world.context: In the 4 November midterm elections Democrats took control of both houses of Congress, flipping Senate seats in Republican strongholds amid frustration over the economy and the Iran war. Mississippi had elected only Republicans to the Senate since 1982, and Trump won it by more than 22 points in 2024.

world.headline: Spain holds first general strike in 14 years over housing
world.summary: Millions joined a 24-hour general strike over housing costs, with about 120,000 marching in Madrid; in Barcelona masked groups set bins on fire and looted shops, and police used tear gas. More than 50 people were arrested.
world.context: Rents have soared in recent years; a 50 sq m flat in Madrid now averages €1,170 a month. Protests grew after an 87-year-old woman was evicted from her home of seven decades and died weeks later, and Spain votes in a general election on 29 November.

world.headline: Israeli strike on Gaza's Nasser Hospital kills six
world.summary: An Israeli airstrike hit the surgical and intensive care wards of Nasser Hospital, the largest in southern Gaza, killing at least six people, including a surgeon, and injuring 20, Gaza's civil defence said. Israel says it targeted a senior Hamas member using the hospital as a command centre.
world.context: The Gaza war began after Hamas attacked Israel on 7 October 2023. A ceasefire was agreed in October 2025, but Israeli strikes have continued, killing more than 1,600 people since then according to Gaza's health ministry.

world.headline: Building collapse in Brooklyn kills two
world.summary: A three-storey building from 1930 on Flatbush Avenue collapsed into a neighbouring construction site, killing at least two and injuring 17, four critically; more than 250 responders searched the rubble and pulled out a survivor. The cause is unknown.

interesting.headline: GTA 6 reportedly passes $1bn in sales before release
interesting.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI has reportedly passed $1bn in sales a week before its launch, and an ISP warns that pre-loads of the game are slowing down the internet.
interesting.context: It is Rockstar's first new Grand Theft Auto game since GTA V in 2013.

interesting.headline: Google DeepMind's AI formally verifies key parts of Signal
interesting.summary: DeepMind used a new agentic AI system, AlphaProof Code, to mathematically prove key security guarantees of the Signal protocol in four weeks. It found no new flaws but correctly flagged known bugs in older versions.
interesting.context: Formal verification uses maths to prove software works as intended, but it has been very slow and costly.

interesting.headline: Pochettino set to become Manchester United manager
interesting.summary: United have opened talks with USA coach Mauricio Pochettino, who is ready to take the job if Michael Carrick is sacked as expected; United are 18th in the Premier League and would have to pay $10m to release him.

interesting.headline: Jamie Dornan wraps filming as Aragorn in 'The Hunt for Gollum'
interesting.summary: Jamie Dornan, who takes over Aragorn from Viggo Mortensen, has finished filming Andy Serkis's 'The Lord of the Rings: The Hunt for Gollum', with Ian McKellen, Elijah Wood and Kate Winslet also in the cast.
interesting.context: Serkis also directs and returns as Gollum; the story is set between The Hobbit and The Lord of the Rings.

ongoing.title: Russia-Ukraine war
ongoing.update: The two-day Abu Dhabi talks ended without a peace breakthrough, but both sides agreed their largest prisoner exchange, over 1,000 prisoners each; US envoys Witkoff and Kushner landed in Moscow to meet Putin before seeing Zelensky in Dublin. Hours later Russia fired ballistic missiles at Kyiv.
ongoing.context: Russia launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022 after seizing Crimea in 2014. Ukraine pushed Russian forces back from Kyiv and later in Kharkiv and Kherson, but the front has since largely stalled. The US is now mediating peace talks, with territory in Donbas the main sticking point.

ongoing.title: US-Iran tensions
ongoing.update: Israel's security cabinet ordered the military to step up preparations for a possible attack on Iran, and Iran's security chief threatened US bases as far as Europe. Iran also claimed a strike on an Omani island it says the US uses.
ongoing.context: Tensions over Iran's nuclear programme became open war in February 2026, when the US began strikes on Iran. Iran has since blockaded shipping in the Strait of Hormuz, and Qatar-mediated talks have stalled.

ongoing.title: Nvidia CEO's affair with alleged Chinese spy
ongoing.update: The board met to decide whether to oust Jensen Huang after the New York Times reported a second affair, with Nvidia executive Kimberly Powell; the shares fell more than 8% after hours, taking losses to about $600bn.
ongoing.context: Huang co-founded Nvidia in 1993 and built it into the world's most valuable chipmaker. Earlier this month he admitted an affair with Alice Huang, a businesswoman accused of being a Chinese spy, prompting a board investigation and calls from Congress for him to testify.

ongoing.title: Saudi Arabia-Houthi fighting
ongoing.update: Saudi Arabia said debris from two intercepted ballistic missiles fell in Mecca province; the Houthis deny targeting Mecca and say they aimed at a Yanbu pumping station and Riyadh airport. The WHO says over 320,000 Yemenis have fled fighting since 1 August.
ongoing.context: Yemen's civil war began in 2014 when the Iran-backed Houthis seized the capital Sanaa, and a Saudi-led coalition intervened in 2015. A truce from 2022 largely held until fighting flared again this year.

ongoing.title: Hoax bomb threats across Europe
ongoing.update: Emailed bomb threats hit 6,300 Italian state schools and more than 700 in Scotland and Northern Ireland; some were evacuated, but authorities found no real danger and Meloni said the aim was to spread alarm.
ongoing.context: Waves of emailed hoax bomb threats have hit schools and public buildings across Europe in recent weeks. They cause evacuations and disruption but have so far turned out to be false.
